scope: Independent actual-PDF MediaBox/CropBox, page-count, metadata-title, embedded Type1 font, traced-text-bound and placed-raster-resolution audit; PNG resolution is checked from file metadata. PDF vector layers have no dpi. LaTeX and absence of in-panel titles are declared by the figure manifest; font size, overlapping labels and graphical clarity still require visual review.

curated_exports.scope: Actual page, font, text-bound and raster-resolution checks of the curated main/supplementary PDF copies and vector-preserving page extracts; source and exported PDF hashes are bound to the curated manifest.
